item.title: Akuma Seijo ~Demon Girl Step~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2018-11-30
  • スコア: 6.16/10 (20 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 悪魔聖女 ～デーモンガール・ステップ～
  • 英語名: Akuma Seijo Demon Girl Step

あらすじ

Ruti is a demon who was vanquished a long time ago and a part of him was sealed away. Now in the present, he was resurrected by the pitiful Kyouka who mistakened him for a sex toy. He hatched a plan to train her as the evil mahou shoujo Dark Cherry and collect magical energy to fully regain his form. However, three figures of justice stood in their way: mahou shoujos Melody Queen, Lionel and Aya.

item.title: Sono Taiju wa Makai o Kurau!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2018-04-27
  • スコア: 7.18/10 (46 人評価)
  • 日本語名: その大樹は魔界を喰らう！
  • 英語名: Sono Taiju wa Makai o Kurau!

あらすじ

The reign of the demon king Hadasht was a calm and peaceful one. His governance was welcomed by most as it healed the scars of the Great War that preceeded it. So when news of his death spread across the land, it was met with surprise, sadness and grief. Yet there were some who smiled with glee as he had not named a successor prior to his death.

item.title: Ryouchi Kizoku
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2017-08-25
  • スコア: 6.62/10 (65 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 領地貴族
  • 英語名: Ryouchi Kizoku

あらすじ

Siegfried is the fourth son from a small poor noble family who won some land thanks to his battle contributions. He founded a new Maired clan and ruled over a vast territory in the southern part of the kingdom. He thought that it would be a pleasant and relaxing life, but he wasn’t ready for the amount of work that was involved. Of course, there’s lots of paperwork and required appearances, but also having to answer to faction requests, making babies and naming a future successor? Everything was new to him and the only people to help him was the daughter of a ruined noble family, a knight who had been dismissed with dishonour, and a high-class prostitute. He didn’t know if they could be relied on, but nevertheless he takes his first step towards successfully managing his territory.

item.title: Noroi no Maken ni Yamitsuki Otome
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2017-03-24
  • スコア: 6.8/10 (71 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 呪いの魔剣に闇憑き乙女
  • 英語名: Noroi no Maken ni Yamitsuki Otome

あらすじ

A long time ago, the continent was peaceful until a black mist enveloped the kingdom, making ill all those who touched it. The citizens believed that it was the work of a demon lord and became scared to leave their own homes. When the beautiful princess also fell ill, the king beseeched someone to defeat the demon lord in exchange for a reward. One young man offered to do it in exchange for the princess’ hand in marriage. Together with his friends, he defeated the demon lord, who vowed to be resurrected one day to get his revenge. The young man returned to the cheers of the people who called him the ‘hero’.

item.title: Planet Dragon
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2016-06-24
  • スコア: 6.779999999999999/10 (40 人評価)
  • 日本語名: プラネット ドラゴン
  • 英語名: Planet Dragon

あらすじ

When Yoshitsune awoke from cryosleep, he found himself in space. Mankind had flown out to space and inhabited many planets. After many twists and turns, he acquired a cargo ship (and the excellent accompanying navigation support doll Sakura) and started a shipping company. However, it is now an era of lowered sexual desire where holding hands was akin to kissing. Labelled as a ‘lewd beast’ for following the customs from the past era, Yoshitsune awakened the sexual desires of the women around him, causing trouble non-stop.

item.title: Sono Kojou ni Yuusha Hou Ari!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2015-12-18
  • スコア: 7.340000000000001/10 (77 人評価)
  • 日本語名: その古城に勇者砲あり！
  • 英語名: Sono Kojou ni Yuusha Hou Ari!

あらすじ

The hero Oura arrived at an old castle on his journey to defeat the demon king. By chance, he discovered an ancient super-weapon called the ‘hero cannon’ (yuusha-hou), which only activates after having sex with girls! Together with the failure succubus Tina, envious osananajimi and healer Flare, overly serious royal knight Mira, and selfish magician Ekuri, Oura’s ecchi battle begins!

item.title: Akuma Musume no Kanban Ryouri
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2015-02-27
  • スコア: 7.340000000000001/10 (85 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 悪魔娘の看板料理
  • 英語名: Akuma Musume no Kanban Ryouri

あらすじ

Located at the main crossroads, the town of Kaste is known for being a border town with monsters appearing nearby. Gin decides to start his second life by opening a shop in a corner of this town. However, things don’t go smoothly for a newcomer to the business: there’s problems with the locals, roaming monsters and brawling adventurers. Lucky for him, he has his trustworthy allies at his side! With their help (and troubles), will his shop become prosperous?

item.title: Out Vegetables
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2014-06-27
  • スコア: 7.040000000000001/10 (41 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アウトベジタブルズ
  • 英語名: Out Vegetables

别名

  • Out Vegetable‛＼s

あらすじ

There were two wishes in the world: one was an immoral wish to become a phantom thief, the other was a perverted wish to have one’s treasure stolen by a phantom thief. It would not have been a problem if wishes stayed as wishes, but the two people who harboured these desires met each other. A ‘night festival’ was established under the dark side of a mega-corporation as a competition for phantom thieves. This is where the story begins for Zenshirou and the two phantom thieves-in-training girls who he leads, Tomoe and Mirai

item.title: Mon o Mamoru Oshigoto
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2012-09-28
  • スコア: 6.890000000000001/10 (40 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 門を守るお仕事
  • 英語名: Mon o Mamoru Oshigoto

あらすじ

The powerful Lycana Kingdom and Grafford Kingdom constantly fight for control over a small country between them. Lilzo is a small trading post which grew into a large town due to the increased traffic from the war. The town employs a group of mercenaries led by Heat to protect the town at all costs. Of course, that means lots of money is required. The mercenaries gather funds by all means, for the ultimate goal of protecting the town.

item.title: BUNNYBLACK2
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2012-01-27
  • スコア: 7.6/10 (1029 人評価)
  • 日本語名: BUNNYBLACK2
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

The adventurer Darks had been bestowed great magical power and eternal life by the maou, and in return he serves as her underling. However, he was dragged into a revolt by the maou’s army and ended up becoming the new maou. He made the previous maou his wife and brought peace to the labyrinth known as the ‘maou’s forest’… but it was soon shattered by some unknown troops who quickly took over half of the forest. After he found out through captured warriors that they were under the command of a group of three women from the heavens, he gathers his troops to launch a counterattack at the angels’ base.

item.title: Yukioni-ya Onsen-ki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2011-06-24
  • スコア: 6.909999999999999/10 (29 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 雪鬼屋温泉記
  • 英語名: Yukioni-ya Onsen-ki

あらすじ

Sakichi’s parents told him that their inheritance is his only if he can run the onsen ryokan for 3 years without any problems. Even though he doesn’t have any experience running one, he is used to them since he used to live in one. He recruits several of his friends to help him with his business. It is not as easy task as there are mountains of problems to overcome, from unruly guests and sabotage from other inns, to severe weather and even fairies. However, the biggest problem is… he won’t have any time to play with girls! Will he be able to successfully acquire his task without sacrificing his love life?

item.title: BUNNYBLACK
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2010-07-30
  • スコア: 7.5/10 (1862 人評価)
  • 日本語名: BUNNYBLACK
  • 英語名: 无

别名

  • バニーブラック

あらすじ

Darks is a perverted adventurer entered a labyrinth known as the Maou’s forest and was defeated by the maou himself. But taking pity on him, the maou kindly recruited him as part of this demon army. Given a second chance, Darks has two goals: to rise in the ranks of the demon army, and to defeat and have sex with those girls who come to attack the maou.

item.title: Shinobi Ryuu
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2009-12-18
  • スコア: 7.0/10 (50 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 忍流
  • 英語名: Shinobi Ryuu

あらすじ

The setting is Sengoku era.

In the east island country constantly stricken with wars, multiple ninja clans maneuvering in the background exists.

One of them, the Suigen clan, started to weaken and its collapse is imminent. Leading that clan is the protagonist. Although his skill as a ninja is practically nothing, his management abilities and his capability to make enemy women betray their clan is top-notch.

item.title: Wizard's Climber
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2008-05-30
  • スコア: 7.2/10 (176 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ウィザーズクライマー
  • 英語名: Wizard’s Climber

あらすじ

Lazlocke is a wizard belonging to the Wizard’s society, the organization that manages the affairs between wizards.

One day while he was going home he stumbled upon a girl being bullied by magic students. He decided to intervene but before he manages to do so, the other party lost interest and left. He then went to the now alone girl and apologized on their behalf as a wizard.

item.title: Ouzoku
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2007-06-29
  • スコア: 7.5200000000000005/10 (73 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 王賊
  • 英語名: Ouzoku

别名

  • Ohzoku

あらすじ

In a world where the victor gets to be king (王, “Ou”), and loser goes down in history as bandits (賊, “Zoku”), the kingdom of Visto started a large scale military expansion to dominate the continent.

The main character, Zin, was a famous strategist defending his nation against the invasion and had much success leading his “Ouzoku” unit in a guerrilla campaign behind enemy lines, but due to traitors back home, his nation was eventually conquered. Now, the kingdom of Elt seeks his expertise to help them defend against the Visto army. To Zin, this is a great opportunity for revenge against Visto, and well as a chance to get a kingdom’s ransom worth of… women!

item.title: Dancing Crazies
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2005-09-30
  • スコア: 6.65/10 (24 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ダンシング・クレイジーズ
  • 英語名: Dancing Crazies

あらすじ

The protagonist, Minase Akira is living a double life - during the day working as a normal salary man, during the night taking care of criminals as an illegal bounty hunter.

His only wish is his daughter to be safe and to save enough money to open his own shop - but all this thrown into into jeopardy when the past he left behind in the States come back to haunt him.

item.title: Nangoku Dominion

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara

  • 日本語名: 南国ドミニオン
  • 英語名: Nangoku Dominion

别名

  • King of solitary island

あらすじ

You play as Aloha, a young man with amnesia who is stranded on a volcanic tropical island with nine other people (six girls and three men), and the objective is to survive on the island, and perhaps regain your memory or gain the love of one of the girls and escape with them.

item.title: Suzukuri Dragon
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2004-06-25
  • スコア: 7.459999999999999/10 (113 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 巣作りドラゴン
  • 英語名: Suzukuri Dragon

别名

  • Nest Making Dragon

あらすじ

The setting is Middle Ages Europe style.

A dragon male (the protagonist) must, in order to marry, amass a lot of treasures and wealth in his dungeon. For that reason, the protagonist went alone and lived in an area where human lives, constructed a huge nest and started amassing treasures. However, soon after the nest got built, gallant heroes wanting to exterminate dragons, townspeople that see the dragon as a nuisance and adventurers and thief out to get the dragon’s treasure came.

item.title: Level Justice
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2003-12-12
  • スコア: 6.459999999999999/10 (14 人評価)
  • 日本語名: レベルジャスティス
  • 英語名: Level Justice

あらすじ

The world is in recession. It’s a given that various criminals whether big or small increases. Because the citizens insistently annoyed the government to do something about it, the government established “special defense agency SAFE” specializing in using very lawful-like actions against criminals.

“Special Defence Agency SAFE”

Their main headquarters are veiled in secrecy, their main goal is the quick extermination of crime. Their authority is higher than the police. By the way, “Special Defence Agency SAFE” starting budget is 380 billion. The recession sufferring citizen’s call to lower the taxes instead of spending money lavishly went unheard. The world is like that.

item.title: Brown Doori Sanbanme
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2003-03-28
  • スコア: 6.779999999999999/10 (12 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ブラウン通り三番目
  • 英語名: Brown Doori Sanbanme

别名

  • Love is a third as Brown

あらすじ

The setting is Middle Ages, a time where peace and war is jumbled together.

It is during this time that utility people called “Adventurers” came into existence.

Monster extermination, ruins exploration, getting back stolen goods, etc.

As long as you have rewards and policy, they’re an extremely useful existence.

item.title: Alfred Gakuen Mamono Daitai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2002-07-12
  • スコア: 6.529999999999999/10 (10 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アルフレッド学園魔物大隊
  • 英語名: Alfred Gakuen Mamono Daitai

あらすじ

The protagonist is a resident of devil’s world and wanted to became a teacher.

He finally managed to became a teacher and started teaching at Alfred Academy while living inside its night duty room. However, various mysterious cases started appearing one-by-one inside the academy, and he couldn’t get a peaceful sleep. The source of this is that the academy is unnaturally overflowing with magic power. He called his subordinates from the devil’s world and ordered them to recover the overflowing magic power. He feels the need to defend his position as a teacher.

item.title: Mahiru ni Odoru Hanzaisha
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2001-10-26
  • スコア: 6.5/10 (11 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 真昼に踊る犯罪者
  • 英語名: Mahiru ni Odoru Hanzaisha

あらすじ

When you need “Anything” done, you can turn on our protagonist and his three companions.

“Anything” goes from babysitting to investigation of extramarital affairs, even criminal acts such as kidnapping or robbery. Whatever it is, it will be done, as long as there’s enough compensation.

Of course there’s a downside to this business. Everywhere you look, danger lurks in every corner. While he didn’t want to see it, the protagonist saw the dark side of a corporate giant. And thus begins our protagonist’s fight…

item.title: Kaizoku Oukan
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2001-04-20
  • スコア: 6.49/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 海賊王冠
  • 英語名: Kaizoku Oukan

别名

  • Pirate Crown

あらすじ

In this world…

The great military power Dearumor boasts an almighty force.

Land is cleared, new weapons are developed, conventional strategy and tactics are perfected into an art which culminates on the well trained officers and soldiers, and surrounding countries are conquered.

Everyone believes that no one can stop their charge, no one doubted that the world is for Dearumor to take.

item.title: Wafers ~Ohime-sama wa Kyou mo Kiken deshita~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2000-09-22
  • スコア: 5.779999999999999/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: うえはぁす ～お姫様は今日も危険でした～
  • 英語名: Wafers Ohime-sama wa Kyou mo Kiken deshita

あらすじ

To escape from being forcefully married against her will for the sake of her country, the royal princess Chris ran away carrying only whatever money and valuables she can managed to carry. Naturally, pursuers chased after her. Being only a single woman, evading her pursuers would be hard. While thinking her next course of action, she saw the protagonist’ car abruptly stopped, and she took out her gun. And thus begin the princess and protagonist’ adventures.

item.title: Aoiya Masshigura
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SofthouseChara
  • 発売日: 2000-02-25
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 葵屋まっしぐら
  • 英語名: Aoiya Masshigura

あらすじ

After graduating from high school, hero succeeded hot springs inn “Aoiya” that was previously managed by his parents. However, business conditions have deteriorated with the rise of rivals. As a result all of the employees with an exception of childhood friend Yonagawa Kasu have left. He managed to rebuild the inn with financial help of his acquaintance.
